parts.latex: What is 0.002073 expressed in standard form with two significant figures?

solutions.latex:
Standard form needs a number from $1$ up to $10$ multiplied by a power of $10$.

Moving the decimal point three places to the right:
$$0.002073 = 2.073\times 10^{-3}$$
Rounding $2.073$ to two significant figures gives $2.1$ (the third figure, $7$, rounds the $0$ up to $1$).

$$\therefore\ 0.002073 \approx 2.1\times 10^{-3}$$

Suppose $a = \dfrac{b}{7}$, where $b = 22$.

What is the value of $a$, correct to three significant figures?

solutions.latex:
$$a = \dfrac{22}{7} = 3.142857\ldots$$
Three significant figures means the digits $3, 1, 4$. The next digit is $2$, so round down.
$$a \approx 3.14$$
The answer is A.

parts.latex: Which of the following measurements is the same as $2.25\ \text{m}^2$?

solutions.latex:
Since $1\text{ m}=100\text{ cm}$, we have $1\text{ m}^2=100\times 100=10\,000\text{ cm}^2$.
$$\begin{aligned} 2.25\text{ m}^2 &= 2.25\times 10\,000 \text{ cm}^2 \\ &= 22\,500\text{ cm}^2 \end{aligned}$$
This is option A. (Option B uses $100\,000$ and option C, D confuse $\text{mm}^2$: $1\text{ m}^2=1\,000\,000\text{ mm}^2$, so $2.25\text{ m}^2=2\,250\,000\text{ mm}^2$.)

parts.latex: Which of the following is equivalent to $1.5\ \text{km}^2$ ?

solutions.latex:
Since $1\text{ km}=1000\text{ m}$, multiply by $1000^2$ to convert square kilometres to square metres.
$$\begin{aligned}1.5\text{ km}^2&=1.5\times 1000^2\text{ m}^2\\&=1\,500\,000\text{ m}^2\end{aligned}$$
Hence option C is correct.

parts.latex: What is 7 400 000 000 written in standard form?

solutions.latex:
Standard form is $a\times 10^n$ with $1\le a<10$.

Move the decimal point 9 places to the left:
$$7\,400\,000\,000 = 7.4\times 10^{9}$$
Options A and C have $a=74$, which is not between 1 and 10, and $7.4\times10^{8}$ is only $740\,000\,000$. So the matching option is $7.4\times10^9$.

parts.latex:
A rectangle has a length of $0.0005$ mm and a width of $0.0002$ mm.

What is the area of the rectangle in standard form?

solutions.latex:
Multiply the length by the width.

$$\begin{aligned}\text{area}&=0.0005\times0.0002\\ &=0.0000001\\ &=1\times10^{-7}\text{ mm}^2\end{aligned}$$

This matches option A.

parts.latex: What is $29.875$ correct to two significant figures?

solutions.latex:
The first two significant figures of $29.875$ are $2$ and $9$. The next digit is $8$, which is $5$ or more, so round the $9$ up.
$$29.875 \approx 30 \text{ (2 significant figures)}$$
Option C, $30.00$, shows four significant figures, and option A ignores the rounding up. Hence the correct option is D.
